1. Consider the function \( f(x) = \frac{5^x - 1}{5^x + 1} \).
2. Evaluate \( f(-x) \):
   \[
   f(-x) = \frac{5^{-x} - 1}{5^{-x} + 1}
   \]
3. Simplify \( f(-x) \):
   \[
   f(-x) = \frac{\frac{1}{5^x} - 1}{\frac{1}{5^x} + 1} = \frac{\frac{1 - 5^x}{5^x}}{\frac{1 + 5^x}{5^x}} = \frac{1 - 5^x}{5^x + 1}
   \]
4. Compare \( f(-x) \) with \( f(x) \):
   \[
   f(-x) = -\frac{5^x - 1}{5^x + 1} = -f(x)
   \]
5. Since \( f(-x) = -f(x) \), the function \( f(x) \) is an odd function.

\(\boxed{\text{odd}}\)

grade.gold_answer:
We have that
\begin{align*}
f(-x) &= \frac{5^{-x} - 1}{5^{-x} + 1} \\
&= \frac{1 - 5^x}{1 + 5^x} \\
&= -\frac{5^x - 1}{5^x + 1} \\
&= -f(x),
\end{align*}so $f(x)$ is an $\boxed{\text{odd}}$ function.
